high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the UNICEF India account. The post is sponsored and features a man wearing a Promise Ring with pride. The man has dark hair, a beard, and is wearing glasses. He is dressed in a dark jacket over a black shirt. The text on the image reads: "Ayushmann is wearing his Promise Ring with pride. What about you?" Below this text, there is a yellow button labeled "RECEIVE YOURS," suggesting that viewers can receive their own Promise Ring by clicking the button. To the right of the text, there is an image of a silver Promise Ring
